text: Both spaces adapters register window listeners, wait for isLoaded or a once-only spaces-toolbar-ready event and then add known extension spaces. The native toolbar sets isLoaded before dispatching that event. Keep this ready-state ordering when extracting shared code or adding a new consumer. App shutdown intentionally skips removal; ordinary extension shutdown removes its windows buttons and tracker data. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Wait for toolbar readiness when populating a newly opened mail window
